phases.title: Establish the governed host manifest and axiom (RED → GREEN)

work_items.acceptance_criteria: The new host-manifest test exists in infra/domains.test.ts, is executed before implementation, and is observed FAILING for the right reason (the manifest is absent). The RED outcome is recorded.
work_items.acceptance_tests: Test-1.1.a: Unit — the host-manifest test proves the canonical-to-vanity mapping and certificate/distribution routing for stoked-ui.com, stokedconsulting.com, brianstoker.com, and cdn.stokedconsulting.com, and fails before the manifest is implemented.
work_items.implementation_details: Add a test to infra/domains.test.ts that asserts a durable canonical-to-vanity host manifest and certificate/distribution routing for all four domains: stoked-ui.com and stokedconsulting.com map to the SUI/consulting distribution, brianstoker.com maps to the Brian distribution, and cdn.stokedconsulting.com maps to the CDN distribution; each vanity host shares its canonical distribution and covering certificate. Run the test before any implementation exists and record the RED outcome.
work_items.title: Add failing host-manifest routing test (RED)

work_items.acceptance_criteria: The test added in 1.1 passes (GREEN) without being weakened, skipped, or rewritten; existing infra domain tests continue to pass.
work_items.acceptance_tests: Test-1.1.a: Unit — the same host-manifest test now passes against the implemented manifest.
work_items.implementation_details: Implement the single durable manifest in infra/domains.ts mapping stoked-ui.com and stokedconsulting.com to the SUI/consulting distribution, brianstoker.com to the Brian distribution, and cdn.stokedconsulting.com to the CDN distribution, with each vanity host sharing its canonical distribution and covering certificate. Rerun the same test from 1.1 and record GREEN. Run the existing infra domain tests to confirm no regressions.
work_items.title: Implement the host manifest in infra/domains.ts (GREEN)

work_items.acceptance_criteria: infra/.axioms.md contains AX-INFRA-HOST-MANIFEST-ROUTING with Why, How to apply, and at least one executable Acceptance Check; axiom validation passes.
work_items.acceptance_tests: Test-1.1.a: Unit — the host-manifest test referenced by the axiom's first Acceptance Check passes for every canonical/vanity mapping.
work_items.implementation_details: Add the new axiom AX-INFRA-HOST-MANIFEST-ROUTING to infra/.axioms.md with its Why (canonical stokd.cloud hosts and vanity domains must not drift onto duplicate distributions, certificates, or DNS targets that create outage and cost risk), How to apply (maintain one manifest mapping stoked-ui.com and stokedconsulting.com to the SUI/consulting distribution, brianstoker.com to the Brian distribution, and cdn.stokedconsulting.com to the CDN distribution; each vanity host must share its canonical distribution and covering certificate; preserve unrelated mail and verification DNS records), and executable Acceptance Checks (the infra host-manifest test passes for every canonical/vanity mapping; AWS assertions confirm each required alias, issued covering certificate, and authoritative Route53 target; HTTPS routing checks and CDN object-manifest integrity checks pass).
work_items.title: Add AX-INFRA-HOST-MANIFEST-ROUTING to infra/.axioms.md

phases.title: Cut over vanity domains in stokd-cloud and migrate legacy CDN data

work_items.acceptance_criteria: AWS assertions confirm the stokd-cloud account ID, each required CloudFront alias, an issued covering certificate per vanity host, and authoritative Route53 records targeting the correct distribution; unrelated mail and verification records are intact.
work_items.acceptance_tests: Test-1.1.a: Unit — the host-manifest test continues to pass for every canonical/vanity mapping backing the cutover.
components: AWS Route53, ACM, CloudFront, S3, SST state in profiles stokd-cloud and stoked
work_items.implementation_details: In the stokd-cloud profile, ensure the SUI/consulting distribution owns the stoked-ui.com and stokedconsulting.com vanity aliases, the Brian distribution owns brianstoker.com, and the CDN distribution owns cdn.stokedconsulting.com, each backed by an issued covering ACM certificate. Point the authoritative Route53 hosted zones at those distributions while preserving unrelated mail and verification DNS records. Update the GitHub deployment secret ROOT_DOMAIN as required by the cutover.
work_items.title: Attach vanity aliases, certificates, and authoritative Route53 targets in stokd-cloud
